head: Mountain Visibility Forecast tells you if the mountain will be out
dek: Mountain Visibility Forecast predicts whether a mountain will be visible from where you are, beyond what the window shows. It was #24 among paid Weather apps on the US App Store on 7 November.
details: It's an independent app, not from NOAA. It costs $1.99 with in-app purchases, by MileCheck.
means: If you plan hikes or photos around a mountain view, it tells you when to go.
todo: Find Mountain Visibility Forecast in the App Store.
